rateSet: PENDING — the verified statutory rate set, entered by a human against current regulation
_readme: Statutory vectors (ADR-0018 §3): real published rates, real expected rupiah, verified by
a human against current Indonesian regulation. None is verified yet, so every entry is
status pending-verification with null input and expected: an assistant never types a
This quarantined list IS track 3's task list. The statutory advisor fills input and
expected from the regulation's own figures, cites the exact instrument and article in
source, flips status to verified, and records the verification in the same commit. The
runner refuses a verified entry until the statutory rate set is wired.
The pending count is printed by CI and blocks release promotion for the calculators the
release exposes (G20, ADR-0018 §5). It never blocks a merge.
⚠️ VERIFY: confirm against current Indonesian regulation before implementation.
